description.zh: 一个小货架：粘贴地址，点一下就在浏览器里打开
description.en: A small shelf of links: paste an address, click it to open in your browser

help.zh: 「最新优先」把你刚存的放在最上面；「按名字」「按站点」是货架满了以后用的。
help.en: Newest first keeps what you just saved on top; By name and By site are for when the shelf is full.

label.zh: 在每个名字下显示站点
label.en: Show the site under each name

help.zh: 关掉就是一行一条，能多放几条链接。
help.en: Turn it off for a one-line list that fits more links.

items.zh: 在上面的框里粘贴地址，按回车。
items.en: Paste an address in the box at the top and press Enter.

items.zh: 不用写 https:// —— github.com 会存成 https://github.com/。
items.en: You do not need the https:// part — github.com is saved as https://github.com/.

items.zh: 只收 http 和 https 链接。file: 和 javascript: 会被拒，因为它们能读本地文件或执行代码。
items.en: Only http and https links are accepted. file: and javascript: are refused, because they can read local files or run code.

items.zh: 同一个地址存两次只会提示已经在货架上 —— 不会存出重复的。
items.en: Saving the same address twice just says it is already on the shelf — no duplicates.

items.zh: 把鼠标停在一行上，点 × 删掉。
items.en: Hover a row and click the × to remove it.

items.zh: 点一行（或在行上按回车）用默认浏览器打开。
items.en: Click a row (or press Enter on it) to open it in your default browser.

items.zh: 这需要「打开链接」权限。没有的话卡片会直说，而不是什么都不发生。
items.en: This needs the Open links permission. Without it the card says so instead of doing nothing.

items.zh: 浏览器预览里没有系统浏览器可调，所以打开只在桌面应用里可用。
items.en: In the browser preview there is no system browser to call, so opening only works in the desktop app.

items.zh: 把鼠标停在一行上点铅笔，或者选中一行按 F2。
items.en: Hover a row and click the pencil, or press F2 on a focused row.

items.zh: 回车或点到别处都会保存名字；Esc 换回原来的。
items.en: Enter or clicking anywhere else saves the name; Esc puts the old one back.

items.zh: 名字留空就退回站点地址，不会有一行没名字。
items.en: An empty name falls back to the site address, so a row is never nameless.

items.zh: 每个收藏夹显示的都是同一个货架 —— 数据按组件存，不按这一份实例。
items.en: Every Bookmarks widget shows the same shelf — it is stored per widget, not per copy.

items.zh: 在一个窗口里加一条，别的窗口马上跟着变。
items.en: Add a link in one window and the other windows update right away.

items.zh: 属性面板里的「排序」按最新、按名字或按站点排。
items.en: The Order setting in the properties panel sorts by newest, by name, or by site.

items.zh: 关掉「在每个名字下显示站点」就是更密的一行一条。
items.en: Show the site under each name can be turned off for a denser one-line list.

items.zh: 货架最多放 100 条链接。
items.en: The shelf holds up to 100 links.

items.zh: 写盘失败时计数会变成「未保存」—— 通常是缺存储权限。
items.en: The counter switches to Not saved when a write fails — usually a missing storage permission.

items.zh: 把鼠标停上去能看到原因。列表会先在内存里照常工作，等能写了再存。
items.en: Hover it to see the reason. The list keeps working in memory until it can write again.

changes.zh: 界面和说明都支持中文了：权限提示、重复提示、空态和「只收 http/https」的说明都跟着语言走。
changes.en: Interface and help are bilingual now: the permission hint, the already-on-the-shelf notice, the empty state and the http/https note all follow the language.

changes.zh: 第一个版本：粘贴地址、回车添加，点一行就在浏览器里打开。
changes.en: First release: paste an address, press Enter, click a row to open it in your browser.

changes.zh: 点铅笔（或按 F2）改名；名字留空就退回站点地址。
changes.en: Rename a link with the pencil (or F2); empty names fall back to the site address.

changes.zh: 可以按最新、名字或站点排序；关掉站点行能让列表更密。
changes.en: Order by newest, name, or site; hide the site line for a denser list.
